parsed.corrected_rationale: The answer provides several suggestions that are actionable. It explicitly suggests that the paper may benefit from more focus on text, and it specifically mentions popular contrastively trained text embeddings like SBERT. It also asks about the impact of model size/capacity. However, while the comment names topics to investigate (SBERT embeddings, model size impact), it provides no concrete details on how to carry out these suggestions—no experiments, comparisons, or methods are specified. The comment therefore explicitly states what actions to take, but remains vague on how to execute them, leaving the authors to infer the implementation themselves.
